issues.description: signing_mode_enum is non-exhaustive and falls through to a default for the fourth (is_hex=False, safe_mode=True) case
issues.detail: The helper handles three of four boolean combinations with if/elif and returns CHIP_0002 as a bare fall-through. The mapping is correct only by accident of the final case. Replace with an exhaustive match or full if/elif/else so the truth table is provable from inspection.

issues.description: sign_message and verify_signature duplicate the SigningMode->message-bytes dispatch instead of sharing one helper
issues.detail: Both functions reimplement the SigningMode branching that produces the bytes actually signed/verified, with subtly different defaults (sign silently defaults to CHIP_0002, verify raises). Extract one pure message_bytes(mode, message) -> bytes used by both sides so the 'verify reverses sign' invariant is textual rather than coincidental, and pick one discipline for unknown modes.

issues.description: convert_secret_key_to_synthetic is an instance method on Wallet but uses no instance state
issues.detail: The method forwards to calculate_synthetic_secret_key with DEFAULT_HIDDEN_PUZZLE_HASH and never touches self. Routing callers through self.service.wallet_state_manager.main_wallet adds indirection that complects wallet identity with a pure value transform. Move it to a module-level function in util/signing or mark it @staticmethod.

issues.description: test_sign_message_by_address never asserts the verify result
issues.detail: The test awaits verify_signature and discards the return value. A regression making every signature fail verification would still let the test pass because VerifySignatureResponse(isValid=False) is still a returned object. Bind the result and assert response.isValid is True.

issues.description: verify_signature carries a stale ':param request:' docstring after extraction
issues.detail: The function now takes keyword args (signing_mode, public_key, message, signature, address) but the docstring is the boilerplate from the old RPC handler. Rewrite to describe the actual parameters, the return shape, and the address-binding invariant, or remove the stub.

issues.description: Local variable hex_message holds non-hex bytes in three of four branches
issues.detail: Inside sign_message the local is named hex_message but is assigned UTF-8 bytes, a Program tree hash, and raw bytes depending on the branch. The name is inherited from the old wallet method and misrepresents the contents. Rename to message_bytes or message_to_sign to mirror verify_signature's message_to_verify.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees the refactor is structurally right: ad-hoc sign_message implementations across Wallet, DIDWallet, and NFTWallet are consolidated into chia/wallet/util/signing.py and the RPC handler shrinks accordingly. The execution is uneven. The SigningMode dispatch is duplicated between sign and verify with asymmetric handling of unknown modes; the (is_hex, safe_mode) decoder relies on a non-exhaustive fall-through; convert_secret_key_to_synthetic stays on Wallet despite using no instance state; one new test forgets to assert the verify postcondition; and the extracted function carries a stale docstring plus a misleading local name. Address the duplication and exhaustiveness gaps, then the extraction delivers what it promised.
